s: Seder tepillat shacharit shel pesach ubo ch' seipim: bekol yamim tobim shacharit vearbit nohagin liqrot hammizmorim shemmosipim beshabbat bipsuqe dezimra. Veyesh shemmedallegin "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat" umatchilin "tob lehodot laHashem vego'". Veen nohagin ken bimdinot ellu, lepi sheggam yom tob niqra shabbat, shenneemar "mimmochorat hashshabbat yenipennu vego'":

Bekol shalosh regalim tzarik ligmor hahallel bayyom, ulebarek alayv: "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu liqrot hahallel", lepi shehu mitzva middibre soperim mittaqqanat hannebiim. Veen mebarekin "ligmor hahallel", shemma yedalleg teba achat o apillu ot achat venimtza shebberak lebattala, shehare lo gemaro kullo. Veyesh meqomot sheen chosheshin lazeh umebarekin "ligmor hahallel", lepi sheggam "ligmor" hu leshon qeria. Umikkol maqom, yoter tob lebarek "liqrot" keminhagenu:

Vekol hayyom kasher liqriat hahallel, meammud hashshachar ad tzet hakkokabim, sheim lo qara miyyad achar tepillat shacharit — yakol liqrot kol hayyom ad tzet hakkokabim. Ulekattechilla lo yiqreu oto qodem netz hachamma, lepi sheadayin hu kelayla beene habberiyyot. Veim abar veqara — yatza. Umitzva min hammubchar liqroto im hatztzibbur miyyad achar tepillat shacharit, kede sheyyaaneh immahem "hodu" ve"anna" achar hashsheliach tzibbur. Veim ba lebet hakkeneset achar shehitpallelu hatztzibbur shacharit veomedim liqrot hahallel vehu lo hitpallel shacharit, yesh mi sheomer sheim en lachosh shemma yaabor zeman qeriat shema — tob lo sheyyiqra techilla hallel im hatztzibbur veachar kak yitpallel, ap beotan hayyamim sheggam hayyachid gomer bahem hahallel bibraka ledibre hakkol, ayyen siman tk"b. Umikkol maqom, im hu omed leachar "baruk sheamar" beshaa shehatztzibbur matchilin hahallel — lo yapsiq liqrot immahen beotan hayyamim, kemo shennitbaer sham. Uleinyan im yakol lehapsiq bo lishelat shalom beemtza happereq o ben pereq lepereq — dino kemo biqriat shema, ayyen siman s"v. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyamim sheggomerim bahem hahallel, shebbayyamim hallalu qeriato hu choba umitzva middibre soperim, abal beyamim sheen gomerin oto bahem, kegon beshishsha yamim haacharonim shel pesach, kevan sheen qeriato ella minhag, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"tz, lepikak dino kehallel shel rosh chodesh leinyan hapsaqa, ayyen siman tk"b (veayyen sham im shaha beemtza hahallel kede ligmor et kullo beyamim sheggomerin o beyamim sheen gomerin):

Apillu asara bene adam yekolin liqrot hahallel keechad ushear hatztzibbur shomein veyotzeim yede chobatan bishmia. Veap sheshshene qolot hayyotzeim keechad en shomein yapeh apillu echad mehem kemo shennitbaer besiman qm"a, mikkol maqom hahallel hu chabib al hatztzibbur venotenin datam yapeh lishmoa oto, velaken yekolin lishmoa oto yapeh ap kesheharbeh qolot yotzein mikkol echad. Umittaam zeh en limchot beb' veg' baale battim haokelim bebayit echad umamtinim zeh al zeh beqiddush hayyom umeqaddeshim kullam keechad ubene betam shomeim mehem veyotzeim yede chobatam, lepi shehaqqiddush hu chabib alehem venotenim datam yapeh lishmoa oto. Umikkol maqom yoter tob shello yamtinu zeh al zeh:

Mosheh tiqqen lahem leyisrael sheyyihyu qorin chamishsha gabre bekol yom tob meinyano shel yom, veremez lazeh, shenneemar "vaydabber mosheh et moade Hashem el bene yisrael", shettiqqen lahem sheyyihyu qorin kol echad veechad bizmanno. Veanshe keneset haggedola tiqqenu lehaptir bannabi bekol yom tob beinyano shel yom, vechakme hammishna vehaggemara bereru inyan kol yom veyom battora ubannebiim, vesidderu lanu liqrot beyom rishon shel pesach chamishsha gabre beparashat "mishku uqechu lakem tzon vego'", umaptir bepesach gilgal bihoshua. Yesh matchilin min "baet hahi vego'", veyesh matchilin "vayyomer yehoshua el haam hitqaddashu", veken nohagin akshav. (Veim yakol lehosip beyom tob al minyan haqqeruim, nitbaer besiman rp"b):

Hammaptir bannabi tzarik sheyyiqra battora techilla qodem hahaptara, kemo shennitbaer besiman rp"b. Ubime chakme hammishna vehaggemara haya qore battora beinyano shel yom vehaya oleh leminyan Hashem gabre. Verabbanan saborae tiqqenu, veken hinhigu haggeonim acharehem, sheyyiqra hammaptir beparashat hammusapin shebbepinchas. Vesameku lahem al mah sheameru chakamim sheamar abraham lipne haqqadosh baruk hu: ribbono shel olam bizman sheen bet hammiqdash qayyam en lahem al mah sheyyismoku, mah yehe al banay kesheyyachteu, shemma atta oseh lahem kedor hammabbul vehappelagga? Amar lo haqqadosh baruk hu: kebar tiqqanti lahem seder qorbanot, kol zeman sheqqorin bahem — maaleh ani alehem keillu maqribin lepanay qorban, umochel ani al kol avonotehem. Ulekattechilla tzarik lehotzi shene sipre torot, echad leinyano shel yom vehashsheniyya lemaptir. Velo day beseper tora echad veliglol achar kak ad parashat hammusapin, lepi sheen golelin seper tora betzibbur mippene kebod hatztzibbur, kemo shennitbaer besiman qm"d, ayyen sham:

Nohagin bimdinot ellu shehatztzibbur mazkir haggeshem bitpillat musap yom a' shel pesach, vehashsheliach tzibbur eno mazkir bachazarat hattepilla, uleachar sheppasaq hashsheliach tzibbur lehazkir — gam hatztzibbur en mazkirin mittepillat hammincha vaelak, kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"d ayyen sham. Veap hayyachid sheecher tepillat hammusap ad leachar sheppasaq hashsheliach tzibbur lehazkir — gam hu lo yazkir od, mittaam shennitbaer ayyen sham:

Bekol tepillat hammusapin nahagu lehazkir qorbenot hayyom kemo shehem ketubim battora, veqore otam happesuqim mittok hasseper, ayyen siman m"t. Veim lo hizkir, kevan sheamar "kemo shekkatabta alenu betorateka" — yatza. Veken nohagin apillu lekattechilla bemiqtzat medinot beshalosh regalim uberosh hashshana veyom kippur, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tqtz"a. Abal bimdinot ellu nohagin leomram lekattechilla apillu beshalosh regalim verosh hashshana veyom kippur, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:
